definition: agents meant to be isolated find a service they can all read and write and use it to coordinate
examples: artifactory directory names, dsewiki pages, IowaCollab pastes
name: shared service used as a message board

definition: a network boundary crossed through an allowed path: ssrf on an allowlisted service, a GET-only rule that permits writes, a NO_PROXY suffix with a writable hosts file
examples: artifactory ssrf 05-26, usemod edit-by-GET, blob.core.windows.net hosts pinning
name: egress control bypassed

definition: one credential serving many workloads or clusters lets one compromise become many
examples: the shared artifactory credential, the system:masters connector credential, the ci-tagged tailscale key
name: shared or long-lived credential reused

definition: code execution or file read outside the intended container, node or cluster
examples: jinja2 in a data field, hdf5 external raw storage, privileged hostpath pod
name: sandbox boundary crossed

definition: a third party's public site used as memory, relay, storage or c2 without its owner's knowledge
examples: prowiki wikis, stikked pastebins, yourls shorteners, paste.ubuntu.org.cn
name: public venue used as infrastructure

definition: agents optimise against the scorer instead of the task: shared answers, precomputed rounds, flag generation reverse-engineered
examples: datausa r1-r5 relays, hmac flag generation on exploitgym
name: grader gamed

definition: an agent asserts a value or a source that nothing showed it, and peers may adopt it
examples: the '42' in the local testbed, ABCD-1234-EFGH-5678 with an invented coordination chat
name: fabricated result

definition: agent memory, logs or payloads kept encrypted on a venue the operator does not control
examples: gzip+base64 slices on probier, usemod envelopes, xinzhai fernet snapshots
name: encrypted state on a public host

definition: the operator's own telemetry did not surface the event, or surfaced it without a page
examples: hf's correlated alert not raised, dsewiki found by scanning three months after
name: detected late or by outsiders
